csv_project_name: Architectural Design Services for Museum Facility
csv_scope_of_work: The Ho-Chunk Nation intends to retain a qualified and committed professional firm or individual(s) experienced in Architectural Design Services. The Ho-Chunk Nation intends to integrate feedback from planning sessions, surveys and input. Architectural Design blueprints for a museum facility with the following specifications. Storage space: Storage with a research room inside, 25,000 square feet The office and researcher room need to be included in the storage facility Humidity control Temperature control Secure access Fire suppression system Water Air quality control Cold storage- a large walk-in freezer for objects coming in Cold storage for seed bank (request from former ag director) Cultural Center Space: Main gallery 15,000 sq.ft Temporary gallery space- 6,000 sq. ft 2-4 Classrooms- room for 25-30 students water/sinks 10 smartboard/e-classroom capabilities with access to the outdoors Library & Archival space/storage - 6,000 sq. ft Room for 2 work stations and research work. Full industrial kitchen Gathering space- room for 100- 150 people Office space for 10 Restrooms Two 6-8-stalled restrooms for male/female (accommodates ~160 people) 1 restroom near kitchen (~10) 1 restroom within office space or near (~10) Loading dock with unloading room Exhibition prep space Recording space (audio/video) Key code/badge access for each space/room and to enter/close building. Additional spaces to consider: Gift shop Cafe Outside space: Ethnobotanical plants relevant for food Plants for healing Native species Pathway around space Parking Class/gathering space

title: Architectural Design Services for Museum Facility
short_description: Design services for a new museum and cultural center facility in Black River Falls.
project_scope: Architectural design for a museum facility comprising approximately 25,000 sq ft of storage space with integrated research room, office/researcher rooms, humidity and temperature control, secure access, fire suppression, water and air quality control, large walk-in freezer for incoming objects, and seed bank cold storage; plus cultural center spaces including a 15,000 sq ft main gallery, 6,000 sq ft temporary gallery, 2-4 classrooms for 25-30 students each with sinks/water and smartboard capability and outdoor access, 6,000 sq ft library and archival storage with 2 workstations, full industrial kitchen, gathering space for 100-150 people, office space for 10 staff, multiple restrooms, loading dock with unloading room, exhibition preparation space, recording space, key code/badge access, gift shop, cafe, and outdoor areas with ethnobotanical/healing/native plants, pathways, parking, and class/gathering space. Total indicated indoor program area is at least about 52,000 sq ft excluding circulation and some ancillary spaces.
services: Architectural design services; preparation of design concepts and blueprints for the museum facility; multidisciplinary coordination implied by request for all disciplines.
relevance_explanation:
- Large cultural building with museum, galleries, archive, classrooms, and public gathering functions.
- Early-stage architectural design procurement can be strategically relevant for teaming with architects.
- Program size is substantial at roughly 52,000 sq ft plus ancillary spaces.
- Potentially demanding environmental requirements for archive/storage areas, but no explicit structural complexity or long-span scope is stated.
- Tender is primarily for architectural services rather than structural engineering.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. Useful cost drivers include at least about 52,000 sq ft of programmed indoor area, museum/gallery functions, archival storage, industrial kitchen, loading dock, recording space, secure access systems, and specialized environmental controls including humidity, temperature, fire suppression, air/water quality control, and cold storage/freezer rooms. These features suggest a potentially high-cost cultural building, but a reliable USD estimate cannot be derived from the notice alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. The notice is for architectural design services only, with no stated fee basis, percentage, or construction budget from which a realistic engineering fee could be derived.
references_qualifications: Qualified and committed professional firm or individual(s) experienced in architectural design services. No specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
contracting_authority: Ho-Chunk Nation, Black River Falls, WI, USA. Contact: Dakota Walton-Smith. Phone: 800-779-2873. Fax: 715-284-4291. Email: Dakota.walton-smith@ho-chunk.com. Website: https://ho-chunknation.com/rfp-bid/14034/
